entries.title: Luke 15:1
segments: And all the tax-collectors and sinners drew near to Him in order to hear Him.

entries.title: Luke 15:2
segments: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receives sinners and eats with them.

entries.title: Luke 15:3
segments: And He spoke this parable to them, saying,

entries.title: Luke 15:4
segments: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after that which is lost until he finds it?

entries.title: Luke 15:5
segments: And when he has found [it], he lays [it] on his shoulders, rejoicing.

entries.title: Luke 15:6
segments: And when he comes home, he calls together [his] friends and neighbors, saying to them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost.

entries.title: Luke 15:7
segments: I say to you that likewise joy shall be in Heaven over one sinner who repents, more than over ninety-nine just persons who need no repentance.

entries.title: Luke 15:8
segments: Or what woman having ten drachmas, if she loses one drachma, does she not light a lamp and sweep the house, and seek carefully until she finds [it]?

entries.title: Luke 15:9
segments: And when she has found [it], she calls [her] friends and her neighbors together, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.

entries.title: Luke 15:10
segments: Likewise I say to you, there is joy before the angels of God over one sinner who repents.

entries.title: Luke 15:11
segments: And He said, A certain man had two sons.

entries.title: Luke 15:12
segments: And the younger of them said to [his] father, Father, give me the portion of goods that is coming [to me]. And he divided [his] living to them.

entries.title: Luke 15:13
segments: And not many days afterward, the younger son gathered all together and went away into a far country. And there he wasted his property, living dissolutely.

entries.title: Luke 15:14
segments: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land. And he began to be in want.

entries.title: Luke 15:15
segments: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country. And he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

entries.title: Luke 15:16
segments: And he was longing to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, and no one gave to him.

entries.title: Luke 15:17
segments: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father abound in loaves, and I perish with hunger!

entries.title: Luke 15:18
segments: I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have sinned against Heaven and before you

entries.title: Luke 15:19
segments: and am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.

entries.title: Luke 15:20
segments: And he arose and came to his father. But when he was still a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

entries.title: Luke 15:21
segments: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against Heaven and before you, and am no more worthy to be called your son.

entries.title: Luke 15:22
segments: But the father said to his servants, Bring the best robe and put [it] on him. And put a ring on his hand and shoes on [his] feet.

entries.title: Luke 15:23
segments: And bring the fattened calf here and kill [it]. And let us eat and be merry,

entries.title: Luke 15:24
segments: for this my son was dead and is alive again, he was lost and is found. And they began to be merry.

entries.title: Luke 15:25
segments: And his elder son was in the field. And as he came and drew near the house, he heard music and dancing.

entries.title: Luke 15:26
segments: And he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.

entries.title: Luke 15:27
segments: And he said to him, Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has received him safe and sound.

entries.title: Luke 15:28
segments: And he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and entreated him.

entries.title: Luke 15:29
segments: And answering he said to [his] father, Lo, these many years I have served you, neither did I transgress your commandment at any time. And yet you never gave [me] a kid so that I might make merry with my friends.

entries.title: Luke 15:30
segments: But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your living with harlots, you have killed for him the fattened calf.

entries.title: Luke 15:31
segments: And he said to him, Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.

entries.title: Luke 15:32
segments: It was right that we should make merry and be glad, for this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
